cases.prompt: Write Mocha + Chai tests for an async getUser(id) that calls db.findUser, using a Sinon stub.
expectations: Uses async/await or returns the promise in it blocks.
Covers a not-found or rejected case.

cases.prompt: My Mocha test times out at 2000 ms. How do I fix it?
expectations: Notes this.timeout does not work inside arrow functions.
Checks for a missing done call or an unresolved promise as the real cause.
